## Why This Is Asked
Assess ability to architect multi-tenant streaming systems on Azure with strong data isolation, idempotence, and end-to-end correctness.

- Event Hubs + Spark Structured Streaming

- Upsert semantics for idempotence

```javascript
// Pseudocode for upsert into Cosmos DB to preserve idempotence
function saveFeature(tenantId, key, value, timestamp) {
  const doc = { id: `${tenantId}:${key}`, tenantId, key, value, ts: timestamp };
  cosmos.upsertItem(doc);
}
```

- How would you test end-to-end with replay and fault injection?

## Why This Is Asked

## Key Concepts
- Salesforce Change Data Capture and Event Hubs

- PII masking in streaming
- GDPR delete/tombstones and purge strategy
- Purview lineage and data cataloging
- Replayable streaming and robust error handling

## Code Example
```python
from delta.tables import DeltaTable
# PySpark example (conceptual)
delta = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, "/mnt/delta/tenant_data")
merge_df = spark.readStream.format("json").load("/mnt/bronze/tenant_src")
delta.alias("t").merge(
  merge_df.alias("s"),
  "t.tenantId = s.tenantId AND t.id = s.id"
).whenMatchedUpdate(set = {"name": "s.name", "emailMasked": "maskPII(s.email)"})
 .whenNotMatchedInsertAll().execute()
```
